Visual artist Jason Cook  creates kinetic sculptures and robotic installations using electronics, programming and mechanical engineering. In The Walking Chair (2025), an ordinary wooden chair is transformed into a moving machine. A system of motors, mechanical parts and electronic components is attached beneath the seat, allowing the chair’s legs to move. By giving a familiar piece of furniture the ability to walk, Cook changes the way we perceive an everyday object. The chair is no longer simply something we sit on  it becomes an object with a movement of its own. #art #artist #weird #chair #avantgarde

Researchers at the Italian Institute of Technology (IIT) have successfully demonstrated iRonCub, a jet-powered humanoid robot capable of hovering mid-air. Instead of walking or running, the robot achieves flight and maintains perfect balance by utilizing four jet thrusters—two mounted on its arms and two on a back jetpack. Built with a titanium spine and heat-resistant covers to endure the extreme forces of flight, iRonCub is being developed to eventually assist in search-and-rescue missions and conduct inspections in hazardous, hard-to-reach environments. space Science robot humanoid

Tesla has deployed over 1,000 Optimus Gen 3 humanoid robots across its Gigafactory Texas and Fremont facilities, marking the first large-scale commercial use of general-purpose humanoid robotics in high-speed. The robots use a new FSD-v15 neural architecture and 22-degree-of-freedom hands to autonomously navigate factory floors and perform tasks like parts kitting on battery cell lines—learning from video of human workers rather than traditional programming. Competitors including Figure AI, backed by Microsoft and Nvidia, are accelerating rival deployments, while Tesla targets 50,000 units by year-end and has broken ground on an “Optimus Megafactory” in Austin. #tesla #optimus #gigafactory #nvidia #microsoft

Wooden robots are a type of robot that are made from wood rather than metal or plastic. These robots often have a more organic and natural appearance, making them stand out from their more traditional counterparts. #wooden  robots can be used for a variety of purposes, from educational and research purposes to entertainment and art. Some wooden robots are even able to move and perform tasks, using a #combination of #traditional mechanical components and cutting-edge technology. Overall, wooden robots are a #unique and interesting alternative to traditional robots, offering a new perspective on the capabilities and potential of these incredible #machines.
